reviews.title: Great laptop.
reviews.body:
Bought this to replace my microsoft surface laptop.
Thought the surface laptop was good, but, this HP omnibook is by far a much better laptop, and the price was less than half of what I paid for my surface pro.
Did a lot of searching for a great laptop, and Best Buy came through with the best deal.
reviews.excerpt: Bought this to replace my microsoft surface laptop.

reviews.title: very good dual use technology!
reviews.body: Super easy purchase and a great deal on this HP laptop.  I love the flexibility of both a solid laptop, but also doubles as a tablet.  I'm eager to use this on my next flight as my Samsung tablet no longer works on AA airliners.  I'm very happy with the purchase a couple weeks in!
reviews.excerpt: I'm eager to use this on my next flight as my Samsung tablet no longer works on AA airliners.

reviews.title: Awesome laptop and a swell deal!
reviews.body: This is a great laptop.  It’s heavy in a good way, it actually feels like a sturdy product.  It’s a zippy little thing. I got it to replace my Chromebook which I really didn’t care for.  Highly recommended!
